critical_event_confirmatory_status: unblinded descriptive stress evidence only; an independent safety audit swept A4 cutoffs on frames 34000-35100 before frozen_thresholds.json existed

critical_event_exclusion.actual_status: opened early by independent safety review; never use this interval for hyperparameter selection or confirmatory claims

matched_control_windows.name: control_for_event_1
matched_control_windows.selection: length-matched prefix of preregistered 32264-35364 control, outside the critical-event exclusion

clean_frame_policy.eligible_sources: training matched controls only; validation and held-out controls remain untouched until thresholds freeze
clean_frame_policy.separation_filter: all accepted mouths must be at least 1.5 robust per-view body lengths apart
clean_frame_policy.prediction_error_estimator: forward/backward reciprocal constant-velocity errors from robust multi-frame history
clean_frame_policy.body_length_estimator: per-view median finite mouth-to-tail length, reported but tail never used as an identity feature

selection_objective.selection_data_rule: Hyperparameters are selected on training only. Validation is reported without selection or tie-breaking. Held-out remains untouched until the timestamped configuration freeze. The critical cohort was opened early by an independent safety audit and is permanently descriptive/unblinded, never confirmatory.
selection_objective.deterministic_tie_break: lowest complexity (smaller motion weight, shorter gap, larger ambiguity abstention margin), then lexicographic canonical JSON
primary: training annotated female identity accuracy for selection; frozen-configuration validation accuracy is report-only and cannot change the finalist

tracklet_cutoff_sweep.priority: purity over length; false merge is worse than recoverable break

metric_policy.full_eligible_accuracy: Every eligible annotation is in the denominator; missing or unresolved output is incorrect.
metric_policy.selective_mapped_accuracy: Reported separately with mapped and abstained counts; never substituted for full-eligible accuracy.
metric_policy.control_label: length-matched temporal control, not behavior-matched control
metric_policy.round8_risk_windows: post-freeze stress set, not tuning or primary confirmatory data
metric_policy.female_ground_truth_limitation: female-only ground truth cannot observe a male-to-male swap
